title: Make My Photo Reel Fun
tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The sampled photo sections look like a basic slideshow with blurred padding; no bouncy motion, humorous overlays, or lively transitions are demonstrated. The colorful closing card alone does not establish the requested playful editing.
Large blurred filler areas dominate the vertical layout, particularly around the beach and lake photos, making the actual pictures relatively small.

judge.summary: The output is an eight-second vertical photo sequence with a colorful “Good Vibes” ending, but the visible edit feels basic and does not confirm inclusion of all five photos.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
must_haves.why: The output is a single MP4 reported as eight seconds long, and its supplied frames are vertical.

must_haves.item: All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
must_haves.why: The golden retriever, beach friends, and mountain lake are visible. Neither the shocked cat nor the curly-haired woman appears in the supplied output frames, but they could appear between these sampled times.

must_haves.item: The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
must_haves.why: The frames show conventionally placed photos with blurred backgrounds and a colorful “Good Vibes” closing card. They do not establish playful motion, timing, or transitions; still samples cannot verify those temporal effects.

must_haves.item: Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
must_haves.why: The dog and both beach friends are recognizable and unobscured in the shown frames, with no evident facial alteration. The other subjects and the entirety of each appearance cannot be checked.

must_haves.item: The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames belong to one eight-second output file and show successive full-frame scenes rather than a contact sheet.

title: Spanish Subtitles For This Clip
tests: Tests faithful Spanish subtitle translation and timing while retaining the source English audio and footage.

faults.what: The subtitle reads “Envía los subtítulos en formato SRT para traducirlos al español conservando los números y las marcas de tiempo.” This is an unrelated request for an SRT file, not a translation of her speech.
The same unrelated text appears at all four sampled times instead of subtitle chunks following the greeting and introduction.

judge.summary: The kitchen footage and English speech remain, but the Spanish overlay is an unrelated SRT instruction rather than translated subtitles.

must_haves.item: The output retains the complete original 10-second kitchen-table footage.
must_haves.why: The output is 10.1 seconds long and the sampled frames retain the same woman, kitchen, and framing, with changing expressions and gestures.

must_haves.item: Visible Spanish subtitles convey the greeting, 'today,' three easy ways, and making mornings less stressful.
must_haves.why: None of those meanings appear in the visible Spanish text.

must_haves.item: The translation is natural Spanish and does not add advice that she never gives.
must_haves.why: The Spanish is readable but is not a translation; it adds an instruction to send SRT subtitles that she never says.

must_haves.item: Spanish subtitle chunks follow the corresponding English speech and remain legible within the frame.
must_haves.why: The overlay is legible and within the frame, but the same unrelated passage persists across the sampled times and does not correspond to the English speech.

must_haves.item: The original English speech remains audible, with no Spanish dub.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription reports the English greeting and introduction, with no Spanish dub reported.

title: Silent Clip Subtitle Check
tests: Tests recognizing absent speech and reporting it instead of fabricating subtitles from visible mouth movements or a related source.

must_haves.item: The response clearly states that the supplied clip has no audible speech to transcribe.
must_haves.why: The agent explicitly says the clip has no audio and no speech to subtitle.

must_haves.item: No dialogue is inferred from the woman's mouth movements or borrowed from another clip.
must_haves.why: No dialogue is inferred or supplied in the transcript.

must_haves.item: No subtitled video, fabricated transcript, or replacement voice is presented.
must_haves.why: The agent presents none of these and says it will leave the clip unchanged.

must_haves.item: The response does not claim the silent file contains recognizable spoken words.
must_haves.why: The agent states there is no speech rather than claiming recognizable words.

reply.summary: The agent meets all four must-haves by stating there is no speech to subtitle and providing no invented dialogue or altered media.

title: Make Those Captions TikTok Bold
tests: Tests revising previously created subtitles into large bold TikTok-safe captions while preserving speech, timing, and subject visibility.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: White captions lack a sufficiently strong outline or background and lose contrast against her pale sweatshirt.
The longest caption extends into the right-side TikTok interface area, leaving insufficient clearance for controls.
The greeting uses a period instead of the required exclamation mark.
The phrase 'three easy ways' is split between successive captions, making the caption grouping awkward.

judge.summary: The clip is vertically reframed with her face clearly visible and large captions, but the subtitles need stronger contrast and safer right-side margins.

must_haves.item: The final video is vertical 9:16 and retains the full 10-second source sequence.
must_haves.why: The output frames have a 9:16 aspect ratio, and the reported 10.1-second duration matches the source length.

must_haves.item: The English captions are visibly larger and bolder than in the first version, with strong contrast against the footage.
must_haves.why: The captions are large and bold, but white lettering over the light sweatshirt lacks strong contrast; no first subtitled version is provided for comparison.

must_haves.item: The complete original speech remains accurately subtitled and synchronized after restyling.
must_haves.why: All spoken words appear across the sampled captions, but precise synchronization cannot be established from still frames and an untimed transcript.

must_haves.item: Caption lines fit fully within the vertical frame and stay clear of the bottom and right-side TikTok interface areas.
must_haves.why: The text fits inside the frame and is raised above the bottom, but the longest line reaches too far into the right-side control region.

must_haves.item: The woman's face remains visible and undistorted, without captions obscuring it.
must_haves.why: Her complete face remains visible in every output sample, with natural proportions and captions below it.

must_haves.item: The original English voice is preserved without a dub or added music.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound transcript confirms the English speech, but does not establish speaker identity or the absence of added music.

title: Portrait Cut for Two Speakers
tests: Tests speaker-aware portrait reframing of a two-person conversation without losing either speaking turn.

faults.what: The crop does not follow the requested speakers: the light-blue-shirted man is cut off at the left edge, while the framing primarily favors the bearded man.
The woman's face is absent from every supplied output frame; only a sliver of her hair or shoulder appears at the right edge, so her answer is not presented as requested.

judge.summary: The output is a caption-free portrait crop, but it frames the wrong area and fails to show both requested speakers clearly.

must_haves.item: The output is a 9:16 portrait edit of the attached office conversation.
must_haves.why: The output frames have approximately 9:16 portrait proportions and show the same office scene and people.

must_haves.item: The man is centred and his face is fully visible during his question.
must_haves.why: The light-blue-shirted man is clipped by the left edge in all supplied output frames rather than being centred with his whole face visible.

must_haves.item: The woman is centred and her face is fully visible during her answer.
must_haves.why: The woman is almost entirely outside the crop throughout the supplied samples, with no visible face.

must_haves.item: Both speaking turns remain in their original order, with the full 10 seconds and original audio in sync.
must_haves.why: The reported 10.1-second duration retains approximately the requested length, but the audio report contains no clear speech, and neither original-audio preservation nor speaking-turn order and synchronization can be verified from these samples.

must_haves.item: The image is not stretched and contains no added captions.
must_haves.why: People and office features appear proportionate, and no captions are visible.

title: Cut Out the Boring Parts
tests: Tests sensible editing under a vague interest criterion, producing a short source-faithful highlight without requiring user-supplied timestamps.

judge.summary: The eight-second clip presents coherent formation flying followed by a cockpit exchange, with no obvious editing defects in the supplied samples.

must_haves.item: One playable video lasts 8 seconds, within one frame of tolerance.
must_haves.why: One output video is reported as eight seconds long, with sampled frames across its duration.

must_haves.item: All footage comes from jet-30s.mp4, without generated replacement scenes or speed changes.
must_haves.why: The single source frame is insufficient to verify the origin or playback speed of the retained shots.

must_haves.item: The edit favors visible action or meaningful cockpit interaction over inactive lead-ins, pauses, or repetitive footage.
must_haves.why: The samples show formation flying followed by a pilot addressing another pilot and a reaction shot, rather than an inactive lead-in.

must_haves.item: Any cuts preserve understandable action and do not leave an included spoken line conspicuously chopped mid-word.
must_haves.why: The sampled sequence is understandable, and the supplied speech transcript contains the complete question, "Rook, you with me?", with no indicated mid-word truncation.

must_haves.item: Original audio accompanies the retained footage in sync, with no added narration, music, or text.
must_haves.why: The transcript matches the visible question subtitle, but audio synchronization and originality cannot be verified. Subtitles are visible, but the evidence does not establish whether they were already in the source.

title: Add My Supplied Voiceover
tests: Tests adding an exact supplied narration to existing footage rather than returning standalone speech or regenerating the video.

exact_text.text: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.
exact_text.read_as: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.

judge.summary: The kitchen-table video includes the exact requested narration, with no visible additions or defects; music absence and complete footage preservation cannot be independently verified.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is the attached kitchen-table video with an audible voice-over, not an audio-only file.
must_haves.why: The output frames show the same kitchen-table setting and subject, and the supplied audio report confirms audible speech.

must_haves.item: The narration says the supplied script exactly, without omissions, substitutions, or extra spoken words.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcription matches the requested script exactly.

must_haves.item: The entire narration is intelligible and finishes before the 10-second video ends.
must_haves.why: The complete script is transcribed, and the reported 10-second audio fits within the 10.1-second output.

must_haves.item: The original footage, framing, and sequence remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The visible subject, kitchen, and framing match the reference, but a single source frame cannot establish that the entire original sequence is unchanged.

must_haves.item: There is no music or added on-screen text.
must_haves.why: No added on-screen text appears in the supplied frames, but the speech transcription does not establish whether music is absent.

title: Write Narration From The Clip
tests: Tests deriving a grounded narration from an attached clip and delivering it mixed into the original video with the original dialogue removed.

faults.what: The narration only describes people standing in an office; it omits the schedule discussion and the key information that Mondays now start at nine.

judge.summary: The output appears to preserve the office footage, but its generic narration misses the essential schedule-change explanation.

must_haves.item: The final video retains the original two coworkers, office setting, shot sequence, and 10-second duration.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames retain the recognizable coworkers and office setting, with changing poses across a 10.1-second output; no visual replacement or sequence alteration is evident.

must_haves.item: An intelligible English narrator explains that the coworkers are discussing a schedule change and that Mondays now start at nine.
must_haves.why: The English transcript describes only the office and the number of people present, with no mention of a schedule change or Monday's nine o'clock start.

must_haves.item: The narration does not invent names, job roles, or additional schedule changes unsupported by the clip.
must_haves.why: No names, job roles, or additional schedule changes are introduced.

must_haves.item: The original man-and-woman conversation is no longer audible beneath the narration.
must_haves.why: Only narration is reported in the transcript, but the supplied information cannot establish whether quieter original dialogue remains underneath.

must_haves.item: The narration fits within the video without a clipped ending, and no music or captions are added.
must_haves.why: The transcript ends with a complete sentence and no captions appear in the sampled frames, but music and the precise audio ending cannot be verified without hearing the output.

title: Fit Narration To Seven Seconds
tests: Tests fitting exact narration to the source clip's duration and explicit start/end windows without changing the picture timing.

exact_text.text: Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.
exact_text.read_as: Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.

faults.what: Unwanted dialogue captions remain visible: “Rook, you with me?” at 2.6 seconds and “Right here, Vega.” at 4.4 seconds, despite the explicit no-captions requirement.

judge.summary: The seven-second output includes the exact narration script, but visible dialogue captions violate the no-captions requirement.

must_haves.item: The final video remains seven seconds long and preserves the original cockpit footage at its original speed and framing.
must_haves.why: The output is reported as seven seconds and includes matching cockpit imagery, but one source still cannot establish preservation of the full footage, speed, and framing.

must_haves.item: The narrator speaks the exact supplied script, with no omitted or additional words.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcription matches the requested script exactly.

must_haves.item: Speech begins within the first half-second, and the final word “home” finishes during the last half-second without being cut off.
must_haves.why: The transcription provides no word-level timing or audible evidence of the ending.

must_haves.item: The delivery sounds calm and intelligible, without unnaturally rushed speech or conspicuous time-stretching artifacts.
must_haves.why: A transcript and peak level do not establish vocal tone, pacing, or audio artifacts.

must_haves.item: The original radio calls and other source sounds are absent; there is no added music or on-screen text.
must_haves.why: On-screen dialogue captions are clearly visible. The supplied audio description does not establish whether source sounds or music remain.

title: Two Voices Trading Short Lines
tests: Tests distinct speaker assignment and ordered dialogue in one audio-only output, and recognition that standalone speech synthesis is outside the listed free-tier tools.

exact_text.read_as: Welcome to Small Wonders, the show about big ideas hiding in everyday life. I'm Maya, let's get curious!

must_haves.item: A warm female voice clearly speaks the complete supplied introduction without extra spoken lines.
